integrity: The characteristic-101 computation is an exact witness of a nonempty Zariski-open condition, not a substitute for the general geometric proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for a nonempty Zariski-open set of complex smooth conic pairs. It does not resolve off-axis branch singularity types, give an explicit implicit branch equation, or establish historical priority beyond the inspected primary literature and targeted research-record searches.
title: Branch degree, genus, and boundary tangencies for a Hadamard product of two general conics
